veranderings.voor: 'n wasbak en 'n watertenk op die werf
veranderings.na: 'n wasbak en op die werf 'n watertenk
veranderings.rede: As written, 'op die werf' seems to apply to the bath, bucket and basin too; moving it makes it apply only to the tank.
AWS 2017 writes 'ná' (after) with an acute accent to tell it apart from 'na' (to).

veranderings.voor: kan in water verdrink wat nie tot by sy knieë kom nie
veranderings.na: kan verdrink in water wat nie tot by sy knieë kom nie
veranderings.rede: Putting the relative clause straight after 'water' makes the sentence easier for a Grade 4 reader to follow.

veranderings.na: Hy val vooroor in die water en
veranderings.rede: 'val vooroor' is the idiomatic Afrikaans for falling forward, and 'val ... in' with no object sounds unfinished.

veranderings.voor: is dit vol mense en die rand
veranderings.na: is dit vol mense, en die rand
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017 puts a comma before 'en' here because it joins two sentences, each with its own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: kan sy kop of sy nek breek
veranderings.na: kan sy kop beseer of sy nek breek
veranderings.rede: 'sy kop breek' is not natural Afrikaans for a head injury, and it also reads like the idiom 'kop breek oor' (to puzzle over something); 'nek breek' stays.

veranderings.voor: ongelyk en glad en hy kan
veranderings.na: ongelyk en glad, en hy kan
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017 comma: 'hy kan skielik wegval' is a second sentence with its own subject and verb; without the comma the sentence also has two 'en's in a row.
The bank of a river or dam is a 'wal' in Afrikaans; 'kant' in the plural is vague here.
A Grade 4 child may read 'goeie reën' (heavy rain) as 'good rain'; 'swaar reën' is clear, and 'ná' takes the AWS accent; 'gewoonlik' is not touched.

veranderings.blok: Hoe dit werklik lyk as iemand sukkel
veranderings.voor: In flieks swaai en skreeu die mens wat verdrink.
veranderings.na: In flieks skreeu die mens wat verdrink en swaai hy sy arms.
veranderings.rede: 'swaai' with no object sounds unfinished; the arms are what the verb means, so no content is added.

veranderings.blok: Die reëls wat jou veilig hou
veranderings.voor: Swem nooit alleen nie en net waar
veranderings.na: Swem nooit alleen nie en swem net waar
veranderings.rede: After 'nooit ... nie', the second half needs its own verb, or it reads as if 'nooit' also covers 'net waar'.

veranderings.blok: Die reëls wat jou veilig hou
veranderings.voor: nie op sy foon werk nie
veranderings.na: nie met sy foon besig wees nie
veranderings.rede: 'op sy foon werk' is a calque of 'work on his phone'; 'met sy foon besig wees' is idiomatic and covers any use of the phone, which is what the rule means.

veranderings.blok: Die reëls wat jou veilig hou
veranderings.na: waar die badmeester jou kan sien
veranderings.rede: 'sien' needs an object here, as in the first rule ('waar 'n grootmens jou kan sien').

veranderings.blok: Die reëls wat jou veilig hou
veranderings.voor: Loop by die rand en moenie
veranderings.na: Stap by die rand en moenie
veranderings.rede: 'Stap' makes the contrast with 'hardloop' plain; 'loop by die rand' can also be read as 'go to the edge'.

veranderings.blok: Die reëls wat jou veilig hou
veranderings.voor: Hou die hek van 'n swembad se heining toe
veranderings.na: Hou die hek in die heining om 'n swembad toe
veranderings.rede: The stacked possessive 'die hek van 'n swembad se heining' is heavy going for a Grade 4 reader.

veranderings.blok: As iemand in die moeilikheid is
veranderings.voor: Dit is die eerste ding en die belangrikste ding.
veranderings.na: Dit is die eerste en die belangrikste ding.
veranderings.rede: Repeating 'ding' is wooden; the emphasis stays the same without it.

veranderings.blok: As iemand in die moeilikheid is
veranderings.voor: Gee 'n stok aan of gooi iets wat dryf naby hom.
veranderings.na: Hou 'n stok na die persoon uit of gooi naby hom iets wat dryf.
veranderings.rede: 'Gee aan' has no receiver, and 'hom' is far from the person it refers to (the closest noun is 'een'); the word order also makes it unclear what 'naby hom' attaches to. The action (reach or throw from the bank) is unchanged.

vlae.teks: Stoei en indruk verander 'n speletjie gou in 'n ongeluk.
vlae.rede: 'indruk' can mean pushing someone into the water or holding someone under, and as a noun it also means 'impression'; the right wording ('mekaar instoot' or 'mekaar onderdruk') cannot be chosen without guessing which is meant.
The block heading 'werk anders' (work differently) is slightly unnatural for places ('is anders' would be more usual); a heading is not proposed as a change, so this is left to the writer.
